_doc: Words the inventory takes as pointers that are integers: their value only happens to equal a function's or a data item's address. tools/data_gen.py emits them as the integers they are. Byte offsets inside the item; reviewed by hand (tools/data_ptrs.py lint lists candidates under 'record integer field the inventory takes as a pointer').

0x00400520.why: heap table (name, size, 0): three heap sizes equal function start addresses (0x64000 twice, 0x12f000); 0x0008d3a0 adds base + size and passes it as a size
